subject: AlphaPay: BYOK handshake demonstration & rotation trace deliverables
body:
From: Judy Sato <judy.sato@alphapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@alphapay.com
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — BYOK handshake + rotation traces

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we're trying to close the open items under 'Customer managed keys / BYOK'. Specifically we need: a concise witness statement describing the BYOK handshake process, a sampled rotation trace showing a recent tenant rotation and resulting KV cache eviction behavior, and HSM attestation summary for the hardware used in the handshake.

High level acceptance criteria from our security team:
- A one-page witness statement for auditors that explains the BYOK UX, roles, and guarantees (who holds keys, how wrapping is done).
- Rotation trace: chronological logs (anonymized tenant id ok) showing the rotation event, operator actions, wrap/unwrap steps, and post-rotation verification (token/response consistency).
- HSM attestation PDF (vendor-signed) and any relevant operator shift logs for the window of the rotation.

Can you confirm what you can provide by Fri 15th? If any of this needs an NDA or redaction let us know — we can work with your team.

Regards,
Judy
Security Engineer, AlphaPay

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Judy Sato <judy.sato@alphapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2029 11:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — BYOK handshake + rotation traces

Hi Judy — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide all three items. Plan below:

1) Witness statement (1 page) — I'll draft and include a short diagram of the handshake path (customer -> Redwood control plane -> HSM wrap).
2) Rotation trace (anonymized) — Marissa will extract a rotation event from our staging tenant where BYOK rewrap was exercised; we will scrub tenant identifiers and include operator IDs as role names rather than real names.
3) HSM attestation — Irene will attach the vendor-signed attestation and include a short explanation of the attestation fields auditors care about.

We will place everything in a temporary Drive folder and share the link; final artifacts will include checksums and a signed delivery note. Target delivery: end of day Fri 15 Mar. If you need earlier, flag the element(s) and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Compliance Eng
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: byok-handshake-witness.pdf (draft), rotation-trace-sample.tar.gz (encrypted sample bundle)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Judy Sato <judy.sato@alphapay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Mar 2029 09:28:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — BYOK handshake + rotation traces

Judy — attaching the rotation trace bundle we agreed on. Notes:
- rotation-trace-sample.tar.gz contains:
  * rotation-event.log (anonymized timestamps, operator_role=keystore_admin)
  * kvcache-eviction.log (shows prefix purge and subsequent cold fills)
  * verification-requests.csv (client-side verification checks post-rotation)
- All PII/tenant identifiers have been hashed with a salted prefix; hashing salt is in the delivery note.

One important operational note: the trace shows a 3s median latency bump for first-request post-rotation which is expected during cache rehydrate; we include recommended mitigation (pre-warm hooks) in the witness statement.

Marissa
Senior Encryption Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: rotation-trace-sample.tar.gz, kms-operator-shiftlog.csv

---

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Judy Sato <judy.sato@alphapay.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 14:10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — BYOK handshake + rotation traces

Hi Judy,

Attached is the HSM attestation summary (hsm-attestation-summary.pdf) pulled from our vendor portal. A couple of clarifications for the auditors:
- Attestation covers firmware version, tamper-evidence counters, and the vendor-signed endorsement key fingerprint.
- The operator shiftlog (kms-operator-shiftlog.csv) includes shift IDs and redacted operator IDs; we can provide a signed operator statement if the auditor needs explicit human assertions.
- If the auditor requests an HSM-generated challenge/response for live verification, we'll need a short legal addendum (we have a standard form) — please advise.

Irene
Applied ML / Crypto Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: hsm-attestation-summary.pdf, kms-operator-shiftlog.csv

---

From: Judy Sato <judy.sato@alphapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — BYOK handshake + rotation traces

Rishi/Marissa/Irene — thank you, received the Drive link and downloaded the artifacts. The packet looks good; security will run the trace through our toolchain tomorrow. Two quick asks before we mark the item closed:

1) Can you add a one-line signed statement from the operator who performed the rotation (role name is fine) confirming that the sample rotation was executed under normal procedures? A signed statement (PDF) will close the evidence loop for auditors.
2) Please include the SHA256 checksums for every file in the rotation bundle in the delivery note.

Once those two small items are in place we should be able to clear the SIG BYOK evidence item. If you prefer, we can accept the signed operator note via DocuSign — I left a link in the shared folder.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Judy
Security Engineer, AlphaPay
